text: The mower going up (seen from behind), down, left and right: DIBs 1200-1203, the set used from 16 colours up. Their AND masks 5200-5203 were drawn for the 16-colour set (200-203) and fit those; on these, each picture has a white and a black background, and the black is also the tyres. So: white is filled in from the edges; black is taken off only in straight runs from an edge (a flood fill would run into the tyres); the masks are used where they fit, for up and left.
blade0-2: grass at three heights, 400-402. Each DIB is 9 wide but only its first column is used: one blade, bright at the tip and dark at the root.
